meta.title: Session read state
meta.description: Right-click a session in the sidebar, or use the "more" button at the end of its row, to mark it read or unread. An unread session shows a "New" pill beside its title until you open it or mark it read again; a read mark hides that session's "done" prompt until you open it once. Marks stay in this browser, nothing is written to the session log, and the model never sees them.
